checkRuns.command:
cat > src/server.ts <<'EOF'
import process from 'node:process'
import { Elysia } from 'elysia'
import { pages } from 'kay/server'

// Exported for `kay check`, which checks links against the routes it serves besides the pages and types `ctx.locals` from its plugins.
export const app = new Elysia().use(await pages()).listen({
  port: Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000),
  hostname: process.env.HOST ?? '0.0.0.0',
})

console.log(`Listening on http://${app.server?.hostname}:${app.server?.port}`)
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5
PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay-server.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2; cat /tmp/kay-server.log
for p in / /books /books/frankenstein /about /contact /nope /books/nope; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:4701$p; sed -e 's/<script[^>]*>[^<]*<\/script>//g' /tmp/out.html | grep -o '<title>.*</title>\|<body.*' | head -c 3000; echo; done

kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "bun src/server.ts"; bun run fmt 2>&1 | tail -3; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | head -2; git status --short; pgrep -fa "src/server.ts" || echo "no server running"
bun run fmt 2>&1 | tail -3; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | head -2; git status --short; ps aux | grep "[s]rc/server.ts" || echo "no server running"
